What I will most value remembering from this process is how my initial cautious instincts were validated through shared concerns about anxiety, organization, and group harmony. This reflection underscores the importance of aligning investment decisions with both financial realities and the psychological and relational needs of our team, especially when navigating uncertainty for the first time.
